name: tableau-workbook-skill
description: Edit Tableau .twb/.twbx workbooks programmatically with Python and lxml. Adds and removes worksheets and dashboards, fixes broken hyper extracts, and verifies the workbook actually opens in Tableau.

tableau_public_exe.title: Tableau Public executable
tableau_public_exe.description: Full path to tabpublic.exe, used by the verification harness to confirm a workbook opens. Leave empty to auto-detect.

tableau_log_path.title: Tableau log file
tableau_log_path.description: Full path to the Tableau log.txt used by the verification harness. Leave empty to auto-detect.
